reaction: It is satisfying to see the separate joint structures brought together with distinct roles.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the living bone was most worthwhile: the planned cutaways connect collagen and mineral to toughness and compression resistance, then locate cells and vessels within the same bone.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the capsule was briefly confusing because the bone ends first needed cartilage, although the compatibility feedback immediately performed that fitting.

surprise.text: The lineage illustration distinguished matrix-producing osteoblasts from osteocytes embedded in the matrix, making bone feel less like an inert structure.

arbitrary.text: The required cartilage-before-capsule order was not obvious beforehand; both pieces were depicted on the same elbow, although the resulting assembly made physical sense.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the constructions usefully connected tissue structure to function, and I would be curious to see how muscles move the completed joint.
